text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Smart Falcon has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At her request, we decide to celebrate
by using
the hot springs vacation coupon
we won in a
raffle.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I looove hot springs! ♪ Hot spring
antheeem! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And that's it for the hot spring medley!
Brought to
you by Falco! ☆

text_block_list.name: Elderly People
text_block_list.text:
That was great, young lady!
Very cute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Smart Falcon ends up
joining a
dinner party being held by a
group of customers
on a company trip.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I told you already. It's "Falco," not
"young
lady." Fal-co. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You try it.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Person A
text_block_list.text: Fal... slow?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Person B
text_block_list.text: Good job, Falslow!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No, that's way off! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm Falco—an Umadol on the stage and the track! In other words, I'm super fast!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the feature duet! ☆ Time for
the Falco
and Trainer double-trouble
unit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The lively party goes on for quite some
time.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew! We sang so much!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You, too! Thanks for coming with me,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry about that. ☆ But when I
hear
people singing, I can't resist!
choice_data_list: 急に飛び入りした時は驚いた
choice_data_list_en: I was surprised when you jumped in out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My policy as an Umadol is, "If you see a
stage,
hop on it!" ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad everyone had a good time. They
all
looked so happy after hearing me
sing. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Being an Umadol really is the best! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is unable to turn off
Umadol mode,
even on our celebratory
vacation. Putting smiles
on people's
faces is her real reward.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: ファル子が楽しそうでよかった
choice_data_list_en: I'm glad to see Falco having fun.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehe. Yeah, I am. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That sounds good. Time to hit the hot
springs and
get my skin all smooth and
shiny!
choice_data_list: 後はゆっくり休もうか
choice_data_list_en: Now, let's get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whew... The water was great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, me too...
choice_data_list_en: The night breeze feels lovely, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Do you have fun when you're with me,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've been throwing myself into running so
hard up
until now...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after nothing but reckless
dreams... I
know it must've been a lot of
work for you too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So I was wondering if it's been more fun
or hard
work.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see. ☆
choice_data_list: もちろん、楽しいが大きいよ
choice_data_list_en: Of course, the fun definitely outweighs it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As long as you've made happy
memories... then
I'm okay with you
moving on.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Some people prefer cheering for
someone chasing
their dreams over
someone who's already made it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even some of my fans have moved on for
that
reason.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I don't think that's a bad thing. My shine
hasn't
faded, they're just drawn in by a
different kind of
light.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, if you want to help another dream
come
true...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: まだ夢は終わってない

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 君はまだ輝きたがってる
貴方はまだ輝きたがってる

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: 次の輝きを俺に見せてくれないか？
次の輝きを私に見せてくれる？
choice_data_list_en: Won't you show me your next radiance?
Will you show me your next radiance?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of course... ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I... I'll always, always want you to—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking how lucky I am to
have such a
diehard fan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All riiight! It's decided then!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to shine brighter and brighter!
I'm
gonna be so dazzling you go blind!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah! It was just a figure of speech!
choice_data_list_en: Getting crushed is a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My mistake. ☆ Ehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Smart Falcon and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
